sloka: तदेव रामेण निशम्य भाषितम्कृता मतिः तस्य बिल प्रवेशने ।बिलम् च तेन अति बलेन रक्षसाप्रवेश्यमानेन वनम् विनादितम् ॥३-४-३२॥
transliteration: tadeva rāmeṇa niśamya bhāṣitamkṛtā matiḥ tasya bila praveśane ।bilam ca tena ati balena rakṣasāpraveśyamānena vanam vināditam ॥3-4-32॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana were happy to consign Viradha's body to the pit after killing him. They filled the pit with rocks in the great forest without fear.
